reuse.why: Routes every site that computed a planned amount through the existing getScheduledAmount, which already handled missing, numeric and ranged values.

duplication.why: Removes five copies of the null/number/range dispatch and midpoint arithmetic and adds no new copies.

placement.why: The rule changes in shared/schedules.ts's getScheduledAmount, the shared layer that both server and client already use.

scope.why: Only the rule, the sites that should use it, and tests change.

maintainability.why: Any future change to how a schedule amount is planned is one edit in one function that every consumer calls.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All server and shared sites now call getScheduledAmount

disguised_duplication.where: None; the per-site copies are deleted

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by schedule-template, forecast-schedules, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), the preview and the client
